facts.text: No compared framework treats a solver, simulation platform, digital twin or commercial package as intrinsically validated; simulation credibility belongs to a combination of model, configuration, use and evidence.

facts.text: The compared simulation-credibility frameworks are tool-ownership neutral: commercial, open-source and in-house software can all support a safety case if verification, configuration control, data pedigree, uncertainty, validation and applicability are demonstrated.
